Reasons to redesign

A yard should work for the way you use it.

A site consultation connects your goals with sunlight, drainage, access and maintenance.

The yard feels unfinished

Open areas need a clearer plan for lawn, beds, paths and gathering space.

Grass will not grow well

Shade, soil, drainage or use may call for a different lawn or planting approach.

Outdoor seating is limited

A patio or hardscape area can create a defined place to sit and gather.

Planting beds need structure

Plant choice and spacing should match the site and desired upkeep.

Paths are hard to use at night

Outdoor lighting can improve visibility along entries and walkways.

Several changes need one plan

A full design can coordinate planting, hardscape, lighting and phases.

Questions

Before you book

Do I need a complete design before calling?

No. Your goals and budget range are enough to start the consultation.

Can the project be completed in phases?

Often, yes. A plan can identify which work should happen first and what can follow later.

Will you recommend plants for my yard?

Plant recommendations depend on light, soil, space and upkeep preferences, all of which can be reviewed on site.

Do you handle drainage?

Drainage conditions are considered during site planning. We can explain whether the needed work fits the project scope.
